name: Tokenizer Threshold Context Engine
description: Own threshold compaction with agent-core findCutPoint keep-recent tail (default 113k / 20k); Python transformers tokenizer (DeepSeek-V4-Flash); report tokensBefore/tokensAfter to host checkpoints.

thresholdTokens.label: Compaction threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.help: When local tokenizer counts reach this value, assemble returns a summary message plus a keepRecentTokens verbatim tail under the budget.

tokenizerModel.label: Hugging Face tokenizer model
tokenizerModel.help: Model id loaded by Python transformers AutoTokenizer (default deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash). Alias: deepseek-v4-flash.

pythonPath.label: Python executable
pythonPath.help: Python used to run the persistent transformers token-counter worker (default python3).

keepRecentTokens.label: Keep recent tokens
keepRecentTokens.help: Approximate recent-context token budget kept verbatim after the summary (agent-core findCutPoint default: 20000).
